name: Full product name shown on the store
_comment_images: Put photo files in the images/ folder, then list their names here. First image is the main one.
_comment_videos: Put .mp4 files in videos/ and list them here. They show on the product page.
desc: One or two sentences describing the product.
_comment_docs: Datasheets, CAD, SDK, dimensions. Put the files in docs/ and reference them here. These become working Download buttons on the live site.
